hints.text: Land earns a little power every 12 turns, but only while it connects to a healthy DC.
A land bug. It freezes the cell and, every 8 turns, spreads into a neighbor that is no stronger than it is. Cells stronger than the bug act as firewalls.
The glow means the cure window is open: cure now, before it spreads in 3 turns. Send at least its health from S along the middle row.
It spread. The new bug is weaker but immune for 5 turns. Cure the parent first, and raise the cells around the child.
All clear. Thin land is easy to infect; strong corridors stop bugs before they start.
